Agrees (transcript internally, per README flow at https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk: "payer │──offer──▶│ … │◀──accept──│ │──lock──▶│ │◀──reveal──│ … state = applyFrame(state, revealFrame, Date.now()).state; // → claimed"): ⏎ - Frame sequence offer → accept → lock → reveal matches the README frame flow. ⏎ - Offer id "0xfd65bd4beedbd5bf81249d06c3061e47fc85e48f5affdf74a9d6b9b33d2cdc8e" is referenced by the accept's "ref" field, verbatim match. ⏎ - Accept and lock both carry "contract":"0x4a0ae3c6d8727dbc0cbf5e0931aa2df09bdeb7c63257d4213d9824aa0bf3eddc", verbatim match. ⏎ - Deal room name "mb-p-tclk-4a0ae3c6d8727dbc" matches the first 16 hex of the contract id, verbatim match. ⏎ - Offer "lock":"hash" and rails ["paper"] are consistent with the README's hash-lock path and PaperRail ("One rail ships, PaperRail"). ⏎ - README confirms the terminal state after a valid reveal is "claimed". ⏎ 2. Differs (within the transcript itself): ⏎ - lock "ref":"0xbacb8e0679121805604e78d4737db902499064c652478e1a5da9501519b9496c" vs accept "contract":"0x4a0ae3c6d8727dbc0cbf5e0931aa2df09bdeb7c63257d4213d9824aa0bf3eddc" — the lock's ref does not match the contract id established by the offer/accept pair, nor the offer id. This is a visible inconsistency between the lock frame and the rest of the transcript. ⏎ 3. Not checkable: ⏎ - Whether the fold actually rejects the lock frame (and therefore whether the final status is "accepted" rather than "claimed"): the normative state machine and fold guards are in SPEC.md §4 ("see SPEC.md §4 for the full state machine and its guards"), which was not included in the fetched source — only the README landing page was fetched. The README does not state rejection rules or whether a lock must reference the contract id. ⏎ - Whether the reveal must be posted in the derived deal room versus the public board: the fetched README does not specify room placement rules for frames; the job note asserts it, but the reference spec text is not available to confirm. ⏎ - Signature validity of each frame: not verifiable from the fetched material.
